script:
set -eu
cargo_bin=/usr/local/rustup/toolchains/1.96.1-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/bin/cargo
mkdir /driver/lib
cp "$cargo_bin" /driver/cargo
ldd "$cargo_bin" > /driver/ldd.txt
ldd "$cargo_bin" | awk '/=> \// {print $3} /^[[:space:]]*\// {print $1}' | while read -r lib; do cp -L "$lib" /driver/lib/; done
cp -L /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 /driver/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1
/driver/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 --library-path /driver/lib /driver/cargo --version
ldd:
linux-vdso.so.1 (0x0000e1aa764e8000)
	libdl.so.2 => /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libdl.so.2 (0x0000e1aa74840000)
	libgcc_s.so.1 => /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libgcc_s.so.1 (0x0000e1aa74800000)
	libpthread.so.0 => /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libpthread.so.0 (0x0000e1aa747d0000)
	libm.so.6 => /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libm.so.6 (0x0000e1aa74720000)
	libc.so.6 => /lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6 (0x0000e1aa74560000)
	/lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 (0x0000e1aa764a0000)
